correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, B>0, r>0, the grounded inverse-trace Hessian is strictly positive along any nonzero edge-conductance change. Reflection and connectivity reduce possible ordinary-edge deletion to the opposite even-cycle edge, excluded by the exact lower bound n*sum(centered cumulative sqrt(price/cut-size))^2 >= 2n/(n-1)>1 against its unit-price KKT condition. On the closing-zero face, path Cauchy–Schwarz gives all other weights and Lagrange multiplier, and the missing-edge derivative gives the sharp iff price threshold. Improper Riemann sums converge uniformly to the integrated arcsine profile and yield pi^2/4-2. Exact n=3,4 symbolic checks, independent resistance formulas, derivative checks and finite optimization comparisons passed using files from this package; the proof, not finite sampling, establishes infinite quantifiers.

originality.rationale: The unrestricted single-exception-price cycle support classification (ordinary-edge positivity at all prices, exact closing-edge cutoff and quadratic size law) was not found in the inspected primary treatments. Ghosh et al. establish general KKT conditions and optimal tree weights, and Bhoite et al. give cost-normalized marginal conditions for a distinct fixed-base augmentation design. The present geometric endpoint-exclusion and large-order asymptotic calculations are additional, explicit special-structure results. Since their starting machinery is classical, residual risk of implicit corollary status and specialized prior coverage is material.
residual_risks: Specialized prior work may state the exact cycle one-price deletion cutoff under another equivalent network-coherence or optimal-design vocabulary.
Ghosh et al. general KKT plus path weights make the edge-threshold calculation an approachable corollary; independent priority assessment may judge part of the result covered.
Some potentially related monographs or specialized journal chapters were not inspected in full, and negative keyword searches are not proof of originality.

value.rationale: This is a complete support/topology classification for a natural graph-resource design family under an arbitrary positive closing-edge price and freely chosen edge conductances. Every ordinary edge must remain positive, while a uniquely defined closing edge has an exact deletion price growing quadratically with cycle size and a universal nonzero limit constant. The exact crossing and scaling distinguish a nontrivial network reliability/resource allocation boundary from generic KKT recipes or an arbitrary numerical case.
